notes: A brand-new Vibe Coding Universe. The community chat has its own look: floating glass panels that follow your theme, message bubbles, replies, reactions, pins, image uploads, GIFs, a full emoji picker, slash commands, group chats and a Ctrl+K jump search. The globe is now a cinematic, real-time Earth: day and night from the live sun, glowing city lights, drifting clouds, an atmosphere glow, light-beam markers for everyone online and comets between cities. Also fixes the globe flickering black and blank emoji in chat.
